title: Aviation Hoist Air-Lift
description: On Friday, August 14, 2020, Charlie Company, 3-126th Aviation Regiment, Vermont National Guard, assisted with the rescue of an injured hiker on Spruce Mountain in Vermont.
keywords: Charlie Company, Vermont National Guard, VTARNG, VTNG, 3/126th Aviation Regiment, Spruce Mountain, rescue, Vermont
unit_name: Joint Force Headquarters - Vermont National Guard Public Affairs
